content.description:
The content of the script. It may contain custom-defined tags that can be used for setting dynamic parameters.
The format to set dynamic parameters is: `<ORAP><ON>param name</ON><OV>param value</OV><OS>isParamValueSecret(true/false)</OS></ORAP>`.
Param value and isParamValueSecret are optional, the default value for isParamValueSecret is false.
Examples:
With mandatory param name : `<ORAP><ON>param name</ON></ORAP>`
With parameter name and value : `<ORAP><ON>param name</ON><OV>param value</OV></ORAP>`
Note that the content is valid if it matches the given content type. For example, if the content type is SIDE, then the content should be in Side script format. If the content type is JS, then the content should be in JavaScript format. If the content type is PLAYWRIGHT_TS, then the content should be in TypeScript format.

contentFileName.description: File name of the uploaded script content.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

displayName.description: Unique name that can be edited. The name should not contain any confidential information.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description:
The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the script.
scriptId is mandatory for creation of SCRIPTED_BROWSER and SCRIPTED_REST monitor types. For other monitor types, it should be set to null.

parameters.description: List of script parameters. Example: `[{"scriptParameter": {"paramName": "userid", "paramValue":"testuser", "isSecret": false}, "isOverwritten": false}]`

timeCreated.description:
The time the resource was created, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-12T22:47:12.613Z`

timeUpdated.description:
The time the resource was updated, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-13T22:47:12.613Z`

timeUploaded.description: The time the script was uploaded.

MonitorStatusCountMap.description:
Details of the monitor count per state.
Example: `{ "total" : 5, "enabled" : 3 , "disabled" : 2, "invalid" : 0 }`

disabled.description: Number of disabled monitors using the script.

enabled.description: Number of enabled monitors using the script.

invalid.description: Number of invalid monitors using the script.

total.description: Total number of monitors using the script.

ScriptParameter.description:
Details of the script parameters, paramName must be from the script content and
these details can be used to overwrite the default parameter present in the script content.

isSecret.description: If the parameter value is secret and should be kept confidential, then set isSecret to true.

ScriptParameterInfo.description:
Information about script parameters.
isOverwritten specifies that the default parameter present in the script content is overwritten.

isOverwritten.description: If parameter value is default or overwritten.
